summary.text: Steve Owens is a Democratic state representative from the 29th Middlesex District who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a transportation consultant who lives in Watertown.

paragraphs.text: Steve Owens lives in Watertown, Massachusetts, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and computer science from Brown University, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a transportation consultant.
Owens assumed office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Democrat Jonathan Hecht.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to joint committees including Transportation and Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity, and was vice chair of the Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development Joint Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
